name: doors-locks-exact-fact
title: Walking Beam brief
query: Does the brief mention locks on doors?
body:
The sober living property should be staged before intake.

Safety basics matter: each bedroom needs a clean bed, clear house rules, and locks on doors before residents arrive.

Demand should be built before the lease is signed.

name: demand-before-signing
title: Walking Beam brief
query: What should happen before signing the lease?
body: Build demand before you sign. Talk to hospitals, clinics, social services, and nonprofits in the months leading up to opening.
